headline: Clamped Pockels r51 of tetragonal BTO is dominated by the ionic soft-optical-phonon contribution scaling as 1/omega^2; r51 rises steeply as Ti off-centering (and soft-mode frequency) decreases. Exp clamped r51 = 730 +/- 150 pm/V.
corpus_mislabel_note: Directory named 'textures-spin-*' but paper is DFT electro-optics (Pockels tensor of BaTiO3). No spin physics. gobel2024 skyrmion kernel inspected but physically irrelevant -> not used.
method: From-scratch mode-sum Pockels model (paper Eq. 4) with 1/omega^2 soft-mode dominance, anchored at the P4bm ground state, plus a Landau anharmonic double-well soft-mode model for omega(disp).
